description: Add a sending domain and start SPF/DKIM verification. Returns dnsRecords (type/name/value) the user must add at their DNS host — Notify does not publish DNS. After DNS is configured, call check_domain. Then use send_email with a from address on that domain.

dnsProvider.description: Optional DNS provider hint for host/name formatting

domain.description: Domain hostname to verify, e.g. example.com

name: add_domain
